canonical_name: No Integration with Enterprise Risk Management
description: Cybersecurity risk management activities are not integrated into enterprise risk management.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for siloed cybersecurity risk management, absence of cybersecurity risks in enterprise risk registers, missing integration between cybersecurity and ERM teams, lack of unified risk reporting.
